title: INFINITY: Giving a New Voice to Europe’s Cultural Heritage Through Ethical AI
content: How can artificial intelligence help us uncover the hidden connections between historical documents, photographs, maps and cultural heritage collections? A new European project, INFINITY, aims to address this challenge by developing ethical AI and Semantic Web technologies that make cultural data more interconnected, accessible and meaningful.
